text:
Olive: lol found a `package.yaml` that says `version: 3.0.0-ghosted` and also has a tab in the middle of a map. YAML is on a date with chaos tonight. :ghost:
Olive: snippet:
```
app:
  name: lovebot
	owner: olive
version: 3.0.0-ghosted
```
Kai: that tab is literally ghosting the parser. it left a note: 'it's not you, it's indentation' :laughing:
Marta: vote to ban the word "ghosted" from versions. it causes feelings and flaky tests.
CIbot: build-check: FAIL - non-semver suffix detected: "ghosted". Recommend: 3.0.0-rc.ghost or 3.0.0-alpha.therapy :robot_face:
Riley: new rule proposal: versions must be either semver or a sincere apology.
Olive: also saw a merge conflict that read like a soap opera: `<<<<<<< HEAD
version: 3.0.0
=======
version: 3.0.1-breaking-up
>>>>>>> feature/drama`
Kai: commit message suggestion: "Reconciled feelings and bumped to 3.0.1 (peace offering)"
Marta: tiny poll: when your YAML misbehaves do you 1) cry, 2) brute force tabs, 3) summon the linter?
Riley: summoned the linter once, it recommended therapy and a strict mode.
Olive: pushed a fix: replaced tab with spaces, normalized to 3.0.1, added a comment: "No ghosts allowed in prod" :thumbsup:
CIbot: merge-check: OK. All ghosts banished. :sparkles:
Kai: posted GIF of a dancing compiler. everyone reacted with :joy:
